notes.title: Progress Update
notes.notes:
Hello Land Crashers,

I haven't made many post's online in quite a while but the game is still being developed! I have found the pressure for continuous updates hard to do as a solo dev but I don't want to completely ghost everyone who wants to play this game so my plan is to do a "Marketing Blitz" where I upload all the sneak peaks during the 4 weeks before release so that potential fans can get a stream of content and not fall of the hype train as easily.

Additionally, I plan to host a Q&A session on Steam closer to the release date, so stay tuned for that.

I feel the audio mixing and the facial expressions of the characters as shown in the demo isn't as good as I would like and I would like to improve it in the future but need to focus on making a complete version of the game before adding polish.

Here's a better peak at Berries gallery picture as a treat.

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Demo Updates:

 The demo has been extended a little to let more background info be explained 
 The main menu was updated to look better and more interesting.


The story's coming along well! I haven't been posting any dev log's recently on social medias but I am still working hard on the game behind the scenes, I hope you all enjoy the elements I showed off so far and enjoy the game when it comes out!

I am running a Kickstarter campaign so that I can commit more time to working on the game. Check it out if you are interested or want to support the game! 

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/crashlandfantasy/crash-land-fantasy-si-fi-fantasy-adventure-story-game
